'''Kob Mondray''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Ochotl]] who lived during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A promising [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] player, he abandoned the sport to join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] over the mistreatment of his homeworld.

==Biography==
Mondray developed a talent for [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]], and after he helped to led his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] shockball team in the [[Airam Sector Championships]] in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], he attracted the attention of shockball talent scouts from the planet [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. Mondray subsequently signed for the [[Eriadu Patriots/Legends|Eriadu Patriots]] shockball team and with them he competed in the elite [[Galactic League/Legends|Galactic League]] shockball competition. In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], Mondray and his friend and rival [[Gettle Tebron]] of the [[Shad Furies/Legends|Shad Furies]] team were signed for the rival [[Kuat Artisans]] team. The pair helped to guide the team to the Galactic League finals, but were defeated in the final bout of the tournament by the [[Commenor Diamonds]]. The [[26 BBY/Legends|following year]], the Artisans recovered from the setback and Mondray and Tebron led the team to a Galactic League victory.

Though his sporting success brought him fame and fortune, Mondray stayed in touch with his roots and became concerned about the plight of his homeworld Ochotl, which was blighted by a failure of its [[Chak-root/Legends|chak-root]] crop and attacks from [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. The failure of the [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|Republic Outland Regions Security Force]], based on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]], to respond to the incidents drove Ochotl and the rest of the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] to secede from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Following his homeworld, Mondray abandoned shockball and his team to enter the service of the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Mondray went on to [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|participate]] in [[Battle of Shumavar (Clone Wars)|fighting]] on the worlds [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]] and [[Shumavar/Legends|Shumavar]], and later on he became a gifted speaker for the Confederacy of Independent Systems, appearing at events such as the [[Conclave of Chanosant]]. At the conclusion of the conflict spent a short [[Time/Legends|time]] in [[Prison/Legends|prison]], until he was eventually pardoned and released on the orders of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] as part of the [[Outer Rim reconciliation efforts]].
